title: Supplier reconciliation
coverage: Only known obligations for this device, company and store within the queried period. This is not the full finances, profit, bank statement or bank-confirmed payment.
asOfWarning: The reference date classifies overdue items; payments and balances are current at query time, not historical balances for that date.
printHelp: Choose Save as PDF in the print dialog. The report includes its heading, period and unit; printer options depend on your system.
sheetHelp: Copy of up to 500 suppliers in cents, without automatic refresh. Requires financial-source and spreadsheet access.
sheetLimit: The summary exceeds 500 suppliers. Refine filters to send it without truncation.
name: Name
empty: No suppliers match the selected scope.
stale: Query the new dates before exporting or opening documents.
invalid: Totals could not be reconciled. Refresh the query; no value was replaced with zero.
exportFailed: The file could not be generated. Try again.
noSheets: Your profile cannot send this report to sheets.
scopeHelp: List filters and selection define this report. If selected, only selected installments still visible in the filter are included.
ageHelp: Bands divide only the balance of approved installments. Principal and applied cash are not counted twice. Due dates outside the period are excluded.
notice: Informational: does not execute payments or change documents.
printLimit: To print, filter or select up to 500 installments. CSV and XLSX remain available for the full scope.
